title: Elf Bar FB1000 EBC Replacement Coil 0.8 Ohm 5PK
description: The Elf Bar FB1000 Pod Kit pod kit is a versatile vape device designed to be simple to use and compact enough to take anywhere. This pack of 5 replacement coils from the EBC series feature a mesh build for a larger surface area, improving flavour and heat-up time. The coils mimic Voopoo’s simple Push-and-Play ( PnP ) design for ease of use, and provide an exceptionally flavoursome MTL (mouth-to-lung) experience when combined with the Elf Bar FB1000 pod kit. Features For use with Elf Bar FB1000 refillable pod kit 0.8ohm resistance Ideal for Nic Salt, 50/50 & High PG E-Liquid
